words.definition: makes you want to know more; not boring

sentences.sentence: This movie is more interesting than the last one.
The museum is interesting for children.
Do you find this topic interesting?

words.definition: not interesting; makes you feel tired of it

sentences.sentence: The lesson was boring yesterday.
Waiting at the airport can be boring.
Is this book boring for you?

words.definition: very pretty

sentences.sentence: The city has beautiful old buildings.
She bought a beautiful dress for the party.
Isn’t this view beautiful?

words.definition: not pretty; not nice to look at

sentences.sentence: These shoes look ugly but they are comfortable.
The building is ugly on the outside.
Do you think this colour is ugly?

words.definition: costing little money

sentences.sentence: We found a cheap hotel near the station.
The tickets were cheap because of the sale.
Is this brand really cheap?

words.definition: costing a lot of money

sentences.sentence: Eating out is expensive in that area.
This coat is more expensive than the blue one.
Is it expensive to live here?

words.definition: giving a good, relaxed feeling

sentences.sentence: These shoes are comfortable for long walks.
The sofa is comfortable to sit on.
Is this chair comfortable enough?

words.definition: not easy; needing much effort

sentences.sentence: The instructions are difficult to follow.
Driving in the rain can be difficult.
Is this exercise difficult for you?

words.definition: easy to do or understand

sentences.sentence: This app has a simple design.
Keep the rules simple and clear.
Is the process simple to learn?

words.definition: helpful for doing something

sentences.sentence: The map is useful when you travel.
This video is useful for beginners.
Is a diary useful for you?

words.definition: prepared to start or do something

sentences.sentence: Dinner is ready now.
Call me when you are ready.
Are you ready to start?

words.definition: good for your body; not ill

sentences.sentence: A healthy lunch includes fruit and vegetables.
She chooses healthy snacks at work.
Is this breakfast healthy enough?

words.definition: sick; not well

sentences.sentence: He felt ill after the journey.
The child is ill and stays at home.
Are you still ill today?

words.definition: doing things slowly and thinking, so nothing bad happens

sentences.sentence: Be careful when you cross the road.
We need a careful plan for the move.
Can you be careful with this glass?

words.definition: kind and nice to people; easy to talk to

sentences.sentence: The staff are friendly and helpful.
Our neighbours are very friendly.
Is your teacher friendly?

words.definition: not kind or warm to people

sentences.sentence: The man at the desk was unfriendly.
An unfriendly tone can cause problems.
Was the email unfriendly?

words.definition: with a lot of loud sounds

sentences.sentence: The café is noisy at lunchtime.
Our old fan is noisy at night.
Is your street noisy?

words.definition: with little or no sound

sentences.sentence: The library is quiet and warm.
We found a quiet place to study.
Is this room quiet enough?

words.definition: not safe; may cause harm

sentences.sentence: That road is dangerous in winter.
It is dangerous to swim here after dark.
Is it dangerous to cycle there?

words.definition: not in danger; protected

sentences.sentence: This area is safe for children.
Wear a helmet to stay safe.
Is the neighbourhood safe at night?

words.definition: new in style or ideas; from recent times

sentences.sentence: They live in a modern flat near the river.
We use modern tools at work.
Is the design modern enough?

words.definition: old style; done as people did before

sentences.sentence: We enjoy traditional music at the festival.
This restaurant serves traditional dishes.
Is this a traditional recipe?
